_metadata.purpose: Editorial set-asides for the consolidated offline batch (unique-candidate-picks.csv, 2026-10-22 snapshot). Each entry passed the batch's own independent review but is kept OUT of the library for now, with the reason, for a later owner or parent look. Nothing here is a rejection: no rejections.json entry is written and the pair stays open.
_metadata.by: coordinator (import session 2026-10-21), editorial screen: every row flagged by a mechanical screen (reviewer notes naming familiarity/regional/technical risk, hedged per-word lines on both sides, hints of 11+ letters, non-letter spellings, sensitive words) was read, plus a random sample of 150 unflagged rows. The remaining unflagged rows were not individually read.

categories.regional: British or regional usage a general U.S. audience may not know (drafting brief: flag regional words honestly; the owner plays with U.S. friends)
categories.obscure: specialist vocabulary or trivia (owner calibration: obscure trivia fails)
categories.weak: one-sided, generic or loose link: the hint does not really point at one of the targets
categories.sensitive: politically loaded, drug or tragedy references; not clearly family-friendly
categories.spelling: owner rule 2026-10-21: genuinely common hyphenated words and names are allowed (WALL-E, SPIDER-MAN, PAC-MAN, SCI-FI, DOUBLE-DECKER); a hyphen or a run-together spelling must not be invented to turn a multiword phrase into a one-word hint (IRON-MAN, HOT-DOG, MACHINEGUN, FIRETRUCK). Respelling proposals are listed, never applied automatically
categories.near-duplicate: a respelling or plural of the hint the pair already has
categories.content: not appropriate for a general puzzle regardless of the bank word it sits on (owner 2026-10-21: bank membership alone does not make every associated hint appropriate)
